title: Zanzibar Travel Guide: Everything Before You Go
excerpt: Beaches, Stone Town, spices and coral reefs: everything you need to know before you travel to Zanzibar.
body:
Zanzibar is an archipelago off the coast of Tanzania. The main island, Unguja, is what most people mean by Zanzibar. It is a semi-autonomous part of Tanzania with its own history and culture.

## What to expect

- White beaches and turquoise water.
- [Stone Town](/blog/stone-town-walking-guide/), a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
- [Spice tours](/blog/zanzibar-spice-tour/), forest and red colobus monkeys.
- Snorkelling, diving and dhow trips.

## Where to stay

The north and east coasts have different characters. See [east vs north coast](/blog/zanzibar-east-vs-north-coast/).

## When to go

The main dry seasons are June to October and December to February. See [Zanzibar weather by month](/blog/zanzibar-weather-by-month/).

## Culture

Zanzibar is mostly Muslim. Dress modestly outside beach resorts. See [what to wear](/blog/zanzibar-dress-code/).

## Getting there

Direct international flights or domestic flights from Kilimanjaro, Arusha or the parks, or the ferry from Dar es Salaam. See [the ferry](/blog/ferry-dar-es-salaam-zanzibar/).

## Entry

Check current requirements, including travel insurance. See [entry requirements](/blog/zanzibar-entry-requirements/).

Read our [Zanzibar page](/islands/zanzibar-island/) or [plan your trip](/travel-proposal/).
